summary: ITER62 refactor + live-notifications regression fully verified. Backend: 43/43 pytest tests pass (test_iter62 + test_iter60 + test_iter59) using the external base URL. Both extracted route modules (routes/connections.py, routes/workouts.py) behave identically to the pre-refactor endpoints: /connections (providers + encryption_ready + imported_activities), /connections/sandbox/import?count=3 imports 3 rides, /connections/activities lists them (no _id, no route_data), DELETE /connections/sandbox/data cleans up. Workouts flow /workouts/start -> GET /workouts -> GET /workouts/{id} -> POST /workouts/{id}/end works and persists status=ended + summary. Manual /workouts/summarize returns computed manual summary + id and appears in /rides/history. /stats/energy returns int fields today/week/streak. Core regression (rider/profile, plan, plan-gate, benchmark/nudge, checkin+adaptations, PRs) all green. Frontend: bell-pill on Today shows dynamic badge '3' matching 3 real items; NotificationsModal opens and renders exactly the expected live rows for greenlantern -> notification-ftp-review (287W -> 305W (+18W)), notification-bm-test-2026-07-29 (Cadence Control Assessment tomorrow), notification-coach-msg (Message from Alberto). Tapping the benchmark row opens the detail view; notif-start-benchmark navigates to /benchmark. Empty state (notifications-empty) is wired in NotificationsModal.tsx and rendered when notifs.length === 0 (verified by code review). Fixed one latent bug in routes/workouts.py (undefined `logger` in exception path).
action_items: Optional cleanup: routes/workouts.py had a leftover header comment '# ----- Outdoor ride syncing (connections) -----' at the very bottom (line 372-ish) that no longer applies after the connections extraction — harmless but tidy up on next pass.

Testing-only note (unchanged from iter61): react-native-web Pressable on GlassPill/bell-pill sometimes doesn't fire under Playwright .click(force=true); use page.evaluate(document.querySelector(...).click()) as a fallback. Real touch works.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: routes/workouts.py used `logger` without importing it (line 314 inside except of _save_ride_history) — would have raised NameError and 500'd /workouts/summarize if the ride_history insert ever failed. Added `import logging; logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)`.
routes/connections.py cleanly encapsulates the whole domain — only leaf imports (auth, db, providers, crypto_util, activity_sync). No server.py dependency. ✓

routes/workouts.py depends only on auth.udb + core + models (WorkoutSession/WorkoutStart/WorkoutSummary/SummarizeRequest are the pre-existing model shapes — workout is a str, WorkoutSummary uses elapsed/distance/tss/etc.). ✓
NotificationsModal.tsx correctly renders `notifications-empty` when the live signal aggregator returns [] — no hardcoded demo rows left.
